subject: Intro: Exec alignment + technical deep dive — next steps and calendar
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Kessler <daniel.kessler@horizon-analytics.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@horizon-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Exec alignment + technical deep dive — next steps and calendar

Hi Daniel / Sarah —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned before the next steps: 

- Business goal: reduce real-time inference cost by ~40% for the Insights pipeline while keeping 99th-pctl latency under 180ms.
- Primary constraints: on-prem data residency for some telemetry, SSO + strict audit logs, and a hard Q3 launch target.
- Key stakeholders: Daniel (VP, Data Products), Michael Park (CTO, will be pulled into the exec call), Sarah (infra lead).

Recommended next steps:
1) 30–40min exec intro (VP/CTO) to unblock procurement + architecture decisions.
2) 60min technical deep dive with our SE to scope network/firewall, quantization tolerance, and fallback policies.

Proposed timing: I can coordinate both — two slots that worked on our side:
- Wed May 20, 10:00–10:40 PT (exec intro) + Wed May 20, 11:00–12:00 PT (technical deep dive)
- Thu May 21, 09:30–10:10 PT (exec intro) + Thu May 21, 10:30–11:30 PT (technical deep dive)

If those don’t fit, please suggest times and I’ll send a calendar invite. I’ve attached a short Redwood 1-pager and a draft mutual action plan to help structure the exec conversation. Marissa, Marcus — adding you for the technical scope and to own the deep dive.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.example.com

Attachments: Redwood_1-pager.pdf; mutual-action-plan-draft.docx
From: Daniel Kessler <daniel.kessler@horizon-analytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@horizon-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Exec alignment + technical deep dive — next steps and calendar

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear summary. Michael (our CTO) and I are both aligned that an exec sync early next week would be useful to confirm procurement runway and any compliance gating. Michael is traveling tomorrow but available Thu afternoon (PT) or Fri morning.

Two asks before the call so we can prepare:
- Can you share a short runbook of what an initial Dedicated deployment looks like (network footprints, required ports, expected egress)?
- High-level cost range assuming 2–4 dedicated GPUs with 24/7 baseline and burst to 8 GPUs — a ballpark is fine.

I’ll loop Michael on the thread — adding him now.

Thanks,
Daniel Kessler
VP, Data Products | Horizon Analytics
Daniel.Kessler@horizon-analytics.com

Subject: Re: Intro: Exec alignment + technical deep dive — next steps and calendar

Thanks for the fast reply, Daniel — and welcome Michael.

Michael / team — glad to have you on the thread. To get the exec call on the calendar quickly, would Thu May 21, 1:00–1:30 PM PT or Fri May 22, 09:00–09:30 AM PT work for you? I created a short Calendly poll to make scheduling easier: https://calendly.com/redwood/jordan-30min?svc=exec-align

On the runbook/cost ask: attaching a network requirements spreadsheet and a short cost note. High-level ballpark (subject to model selection + quantization): baseline (2x A100-class equiv) reserved = $Xk/mo; burst to 8 GPUs roughly 2.5–3x baseline. We’ll put a clear range on the call when we align on latency target and model family.

Marissa — Marcus — can you confirm availability for Thu 1pm PT for the technical deep dive (we’ll schedule the 60min slot immediately after the exec intro if that time works)? Also please call out any pre-reads you want Daniel / Michael to look at.

Best,
Jordan

Attachments: network_requirements.xlsx; Redwood_1-pager.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Daniel Kessler <daniel.kessler@horizon-analytics.com>, Michael Park <michael.park@horizon-analytics.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@horizon-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Exec alignment + technical deep dive — next steps and calendar

Quick note from the SE side —

Thu May 21, 1:00 PM PT works for Marcuss and me for the exec intro. For the deep dive we suggest 1:40–2:40 PM PT (60min) to cover:
- topology and firewall rules (we’ll call out ports/IPs in the spreadsheet)
- model quantization tradeoffs and quality checks (example evals)
- KV/prefix caching expectations and warmup time
- rollback/fallback strategy and OOM mitigation

Pre-reads: the attached network_requirements.xlsx and the mutual-action-plan-draft.docx (section 2 has a suggested evaluation cadence). If you can share a quick list of the models you currently plan to test, we’ll prep quantization profiles.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Thanks — Thu May 21, 1:00 PM PT for the exec intro and 1:40–2:40 PM PT for the deep dive works. I’ve accepted the invite from Calendly and forwarded to procurement so they can start the paperwork checklist.

Michael — I put the meeting on your calendar; let me know if you prefer an alternative time.

For pre-reads, we’ll send a short systems diagram (existing infra) and the current cost baseline for the Insights pipeline ahead of the deep dive.

Looking forward —
Daniel
